literal: Fear indeed of the base people is the conduct; the rest, if desire exists, will arise a little.
translation: Fear alone is the rule of conduct for the base; other than that, a little good behavior may arise only if they desire some gain.
modern: அச்சம் மட்டுமே கீழ்மக்களின் ஒழுக்கத்திற்குக் காரணம்; அது தவிர, ஏதேனும் நன்மை பெற வேண்டும் என்ற ஆசை இருந்தால் மட்டுமே அவர்களிடம் சிறிதளவு நல்லொழுக்கம் உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet analyzes the motivation of base or low-minded individuals. It states that fear (அச்சம்) is the primary force that drives them to maintain any discipline or proper conduct (ஆசாரம்). If they ever exhibit any other decent behavior (எச்சம்), it is not out of a sense of duty or virtue, but only when they have a selfish desire (அவா) for personal gain, and even then, such behavior is shown only in a very small measure (சிறிது).
